<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="fr">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>🚀 Cosmic Defender</title>
<style>
  

  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

  body {
    background: #050510;
    overflow: hidden;
    font-family: 'Orbitron', monospace;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    height: 100vh;
    user-select: none;
  }

  #gameContainer {
     position: relative;
     width: min(800px, 100vw);
     height: min(600px, 100vh);
     aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
     box-shadow: 0 0 60px rgba(100, 50, 255, 0.3);
     border-radius: 8px;
     overflow: hidden;
   }

   canvas { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; touch-action: none; }

   @media (max-width: 600px) {
     body { height: 100dvh; }
     #gameContainer { width: 100vw; height: 100dvh; aspect-ratio: auto; border-radius: 0; }
     .overlay { padding: 14px; }
     .overlay h1 { font-size: clamp(26px, 8vw, 44px); }
     .overlay .subtitle { font-size: 11px; }
     .btn { min-width: min(220px, 82vw); padding: 14px 24px; }
     .shop-scroll-container { max-height: 55vh; padding: 0 8px; }
     .shop-item { width: 112px; }
     .ui-item { font-size: 10px; }
     .ui-item span { font-size: 13px; }
   }

  /* ── UI IN-GAME ── */
  #ui {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
    padding: 12px 20px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 10;
  }

  .ui-item {
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 13px;
    text-shadow: 0 0 8px currentColor;
  }
  .ui-item span { font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; }
  .ui-item .lives { color: #ff3366; }
  .ui-item .wave { color: #ffaa00; }
  .ui-item .score { color: #00ccff; }

  #helpBtn {
    position: absolute;
    top: 10px; right: 10px;
    width: 36px; height: 36px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 2px solid #ffaa00;
    background: rgba(255,170,0,0.15);
    color: #ffaa00;
    font-size: 20px;
    font-weight: 900;
    font-family: 'Orbitron', monospace;
    cursor: pointer;
    z-index: 30;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    transition: all 0.3s;
    pointer-events: auto;
  }
  #helpBtn:hover {
    background: #ffaa00;
    color: #0a0a1a;
    box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(255,170,0,0.5);
    transform: scale(1.1);
  }

  #powerupBar {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 12px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    display: flex;
    gap: 8px;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 10;
  }
  .powerup-icon {
    width: 32px; height: 32px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 16px;
    border: 2px solid;
    animation: pulse 1s ease infinite;
  }
  @keyframes pulse {
    0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; }
    50% { transform: scale(1.15); opacity: 0.7; }
  }
  .powerup-shield { border-color: #00ccff; background: rgba(0,204,255,0.2); }
  .powerup-rapid { border-color: #ffaa00; background: rgba(255,170,0,0.2); }
  .powerup-multishot { border-color: #ff3366; background: rgba(255,51,102,0.2); }

  #comboText {
    position: absolute;
    top: 45%;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    font-size: 32px;
    font-weight: 900;
    color: #ffaa00;
    text-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(255,170,0,0.8);
    pointer-events: none;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.3s, transform 0.3s;
    z-index: 15;
  }
  #comboText.show { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, -55%); }

  /* ── OVERLAYS ── */
  .overlay {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    background: rgba(5,5,16,0.92);
    backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
    z-index: 20;
    transition: opacity 0.4s;
  }
  .overlay.hidden { opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }

  .overlay h1 {
    font-size: 44px;
    font-weight: 900;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #00ff88, #00ccff, #aa66ff, #ff3366);
    background-size: 300% 300%;
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    animation: gradientShift 3s ease infinite;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
    letter-spacing: 3px;
    text-align: center;
  }
  @keyframes gradientShift {
    0%, 100% { background-position: 0% 50%; }
    50% { background-position: 100% 50%; }
  }

  .overlay .subtitle {
    color: #88aacc;
    font-size: 14px;
    margin-bottom: 30px;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
  }

  .overlay .coins-display {
    color: #ffaa00;
    font-size: 16px;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255,170,0,0.4);
  }
  .overlay .coins-display span { font-size: 20px; }

  .btn {
    padding: 12px 40px;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-family: 'Orbitron', monospace;
    font-weight: 700;
    border: 2px solid;
    background: transparent;
    cursor: pointer;
    border-radius: 4px;
    transition: all 0.3s;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    margin: 6px 0;
    min-width: 220px;
  }
  .btn:hover { transform: scale(1.05); }

  .btn-primary {
    border-color: #00ff88;
    color: #00ff88;
  }
  .btn-primary:hover {
    background: #00ff88;
    color: #0a0a1a;
    box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(0,255,136,0.5);
  }

  .btn-secondary {
    border-color: #aa66ff;
    color: #aa66ff;
  }
  .btn-secondary:hover {
    background: #aa66ff;
    color: #0a0a1a;
    box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(170,102,255,0.5);
  }

  .btn-back {
    border-color: #ff4444;
    color: #ff4444;
    margin-top: 20px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 10px;
  }
  .btn-back:hover {
    background: #ff4444;
    color: #fff;
  }
  .btn-back .arrow-icon {
    font-size: 20px;
    transition: transform 0.3s;
  }
  .btn-back:hover .arrow-icon {
    transform: translateX(-5px);
  }

  /* ── SHOP ── */
  #shopOverlay h2 {
    font-size: 28px;
    color: #aa66ff;
    text-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(170,102,255,0.5);
    margin-bottom: 10px;
  }

  .shop-scroll-container {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 720px;
    max-height: 380px;
    overflow-y: auto;
    overflow-x: hidden;
    padding: 0 20px;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
  }
  .shop-scroll-container::-webkit-scrollbar {
    width: 8px;
  }
  .shop-scroll-container::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    background: rgba(20,20,40,0.5);
    border-radius: 4px;
  }
  .shop-scroll-container::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: #aa66ff;
    border-radius: 4px;
  }
  .shop-scroll-container::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
    background: #cc88ff;
  }

  .shop-section {
    display: flex;
    gap: 15px;
    margin-bottom: 15px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .shop-category-title {
    color: #88aacc;
    font-size: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    text-align: center;
    width: 100%;
    letter-spacing: 3px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .shop-item {
    width: 140px;
    padding: 12px 8px;
    border: 2px solid #334466;
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: rgba(20,20,40,0.8);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.3s;
    text-align: center;
    position: relative;
  }
  .shop-item:hover { border-color: #aa66ff; transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 5px 20px rgba(170,102,255,0.2); }
  .shop-item.owned { border-color: #00ff88; }
  .shop-item.equipped { 
    border-color: #00ccff; 
    box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(0,204,255,0.3);
  }
  .shop-item.locked { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

  .shop-item .item-preview {
    width: 70px; height: 90px;
    margin: 0 auto 8px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
  }
  .shop-item .item-name {
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 11px;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
    font-weight: 700;
  }
  .shop-item .item-price {
    color: #ffaa00;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
  }
  .shop-item .item-owned {
    color: #00ff88;
    font-size: 11px;
  }
  .shop-item .item-equipped {
    color: #00ccff;
    font-size: 10px;
    position: absolute;
    top: 4px; right: 6px;
  }

  .shop-nav-arrows {
    display: flex;
    gap: 15px;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
  }
  .shop-nav-btn {
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 2px solid #aa66ff;
    background: rgba(170,102,255,0.15);
    color: #aa66ff;
    font-size: 18px;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    transition: all 0.3s;
  }
  .shop-nav-btn:hover {
    background: #aa66ff;
    color: #fff;
    transform: scale(1.1);
  }

  /* ── INSTRUCTIONS ── */
  #instructionsOverlay .instructions-box {
    background: rgba(15,15,35,0.95);
    border: 2px solid #ffaa00;
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 25px 35px;
    max-width: 500px;
    text-align: center;
  }
  #instructionsOverlay h2 {
    color: #ffaa00;
    font-size: 24px;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255,170,0,0.4);
  }
  #instructionsOverlay .instr-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    margin: 10px 0;
    color: #aaccff;
    font-size: 13px;
  }
  #instructionsOverlay kbd {
    background: #1a1a3a;
    border: 1px solid #334466;
    padding: 4px 10px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    color: #fff;
    font-family: monospace;
    font-size: 12px;
  }
  #instructionsOverlay .powerup-legend {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 15px;
    margin-top: 15px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  #instructionsOverlay .powerup-legend span {
    color: #88aacc;
    font-size: 11px;
  }

  /* ── GAME OVER ── */
  #gameOverText {
    font-size: 38px;
    color: #ff3366;
    text-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(255,51,102,0.6);
    margin-bottom: 8px;
  }
  #finalScore { font-size: 18px; color: #ffaa00; margin-bottom: 6px; }
  #coinsEarned { font-size: 14px; color: #00ff88; margin-bottom: 20px; }
  #highScoreDisplay { color: #aa66ff; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 15px; }
</style>
<base target="_blank">
</head>
<body>

<div id="gameContainer">
  <canvas id="gameCanvas" width="800" height="600"></canvas>

  <div id="ui" style="display:none;">
    <div class="ui-item">SCORE: <span class="score" id="scoreVal">0</span></div>
    <div class="ui-item">WAVE: <span class="wave" id="waveVal">1</span></div>
    <div class="ui-item">VIES: <span class="lives" id="livesVal">❤️❤️❤️</span></div>
  </div>

  <button id="helpBtn" style="display:none;">!</button>

  <div id="powerupBar"></div>
  <div id="comboText">COMBO x3!</div>

  <!-- MENU PRINCIPAL -->
  <div id="menuOverlay" class="overlay">
    <h1>🚀 COSMIC DEFENDER</h1>
    <p class="subtitle">Défends la galaxie • 👆 Suis ton doigt • 🔫 Tir automatique</p>
    <p class="coins-display">💰 <span id="menuCoins">0</span> crédits</p>
    <button class="btn btn-primary" id="startBtn">▶ JOUER</button>
    <button class="btn btn-secondary" id="shopBtn">🛒 MAGASIN</button>
  </div>

  <!-- MAGASIN -->
  <div id="shopOverlay" class="overlay hidden">
    <h2>🛒 MAGASIN</h2>
    <p class="coins-display">💰 <span id="shopCoins">0</span> crédits</p>

    <div class="shop-nav-arrows">
      <button class="shop-nav-btn" id="shopScrollUp">▲</button>
      <button class="shop-nav-btn" id="shopScrollDown">▼</button>
    </div>

    <div class="shop-scroll-container" id="shopScrollBox">
      <div class="shop-category-title">🚀 FUSÉES</div>
      <div class="shop-section" id="shipsSection"></div>
      <div class="shop-category-title" style="margin-top:10px;">🌌 ARRIÈRE-PLANS</div>
      <div class="shop-section" id="bgSection"></div>
    </div>

    <button class="btn btn-back" id="shopBackBtn">
      <span class="arrow-icon">🡄</span> RETOUR AU MENU
    </button>
  </div>

  <!-- INSTRUCTIONS -->
  <div id="instructionsOverlay" class="overlay hidden">
    <div class="instructions-box">
      <h2>📖 COMMENT JOUER</h2>
      <div class="instr-row"><span>Bouger à gauche</span> <kbd>←</kbd> <kbd>A</kbd></div>
      <div class="instr-row"><span>Bouger à droite</span> <kbd>→</kbd> <kbd>D</kbd></div>
      <div class="instr-row"><span>Tirer</span> <kbd>Espace</kbd> <kbd>Clic</kbd></div>
      <div style="border-top:1px solid #334466; margin:12px 0;"></div>
      <div class="powerup-legend">
        <span>🛡️ Bouclier</span>
        <span>⚡ Tir rapide</span>
        <span>🔥 Tir multiple</span>
        <span>❤️ Vie +1</span>
      </div>
      <button class="btn btn-back" id="instrBackBtn" style="margin-top:15px; min-width:auto; padding:8px 25px;">FERMER</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- GAME OVER -->
  <div id="gameOverOverlay" class="overlay hidden">
    <div id="gameOverText">💀 GAME OVER</div>
    <div id="finalScore">Score: 0</div>
    <div id="coinsEarned">+0 crédits</div>
    <div id="highScoreDisplay">🏆 Record: 0</div>
    <button class="btn btn-primary" id="restartBtn">▶ REJOUER</button>
    <button class="btn btn-back" id="goMenuBtn">
      <span class="arrow-icon">🡄</span> MENU
    </button>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

// ── OVERLAY REFS ──
const menuOverlay = document.getElementById('menuOverlay');
const shopOverlay = document.getElementById('shopOverlay');
const instrOverlay = document.getElementById('instructionsOverlay');
const gameOverOverlay = document.getElementById('gameOverOverlay');
const ui = document.getElementById('ui');
const helpBtn = document.getElementById('helpBtn');
const scoreEl = document.getElementById('scoreVal');
const waveEl = document.getElementById('waveVal');
const livesEl = document.getElementById('livesVal');
const powerupBar = document.getElementById('powerupBar');
const comboText = document.getElementById('comboText');
const menuCoinsEl = document.getElementById('menuCoins');
const shopCoinsEl = document.getElementById('shopCoins');
const shopScrollBox = document.getElementById('shopScrollBox');

// ── AUDIO ──
const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext || null;
let audioCtx;
function initAudio() {
  if (!AudioCtx) return;
  try {
    if (!audioCtx) audioCtx = new AudioCtx();
    if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended' && audioCtx.resume) audioCtx.resume().catch(() => {});
  } catch (e) {
    audioCtx = null; // Le jeu continue même si l'audio n'est pas disponible.
  }
}
function playSound(freq, duration, type='square', vol=0.08) {
  if (!audioCtx) return;
  try {
  const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
  const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
  osc.type = type;
  osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
  gain.gain.setValueAtTime(vol, audioCtx.currentTime);
  gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
    osc.connect(gain); gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
    osc.start(); osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
  } catch (e) {
    // Aucun son ne doit pouvoir arrêter la partie.
  }
}
function playShoot() { playSound(880, 0.08, 'square', 0.04); }
function playExplosion() { playSound(150, 0.3, 'sawtooth', 0.06); }
function playPowerup() {
  playSound(523, 0.1, 'sine', 0.06);
  setTimeout(() => playSound(659, 0.1, 'sine', 0.06), 100);
  setTimeout(() => playSound(784, 0.2, 'sine', 0.06), 200);
}
function playHit() { playSound(200, 0.15, 'sawtooth', 0.08); }
function playGameOver() {
  [330, 294, 262].forEach((f, i) => setTimeout(() => playSound(f, 0.4, 'sawtooth', 0.08), i * 300));
}
function playBuy() {
  playSound(523, 0.1, 'sine', 0.08);
  setTimeout(() => playSound(659, 0.1, 'sine', 0.08), 80);
  setTimeout(() => playSound(784, 0.1, 'sine', 0.08), 160);
  setTimeout(() => playSound(1047, 0.3, 'sine', 0.08), 240);
}
function playEquip() { playSound(660, 0.15, 'sine', 0.06); }

// ── SAVE SYSTEM ──
function loadSave() {
  try {
    const s = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('cosmicSave') || '{}');
    return {
      coins: s.coins || 0,
      highScore: s.highScore || 0,
      ownedShips: s.ownedShips || ['classic'],
      ownedBgs: s.ownedBgs || ['deepSpace'],
      equippedShip: s.equippedShip || 'classic',
      equippedBg: s.equippedBg || 'deepSpace',
    };
  } catch { return { coins:0, highScore:0, ownedShips:['classic'], ownedBgs:['deepSpace'], equippedShip:'classic', equippedBg:'deepSpace' }; }
}
function saveGame(data) {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem('cosmicSave', JSON.stringify(data));
  } catch (e) {
    // Si le navigateur bloque le stockage, la partie continue normalement.
    console.warn('Sauvegarde locale indisponible.');
  }
}

let save = loadSave();

// ── UPLOADED SPRITES ──
const MONSTER_SPRITES = ['data:image/png;base64,', 'data:image/png;base64,', 'data:image/png;base64,', 'data:image/png;base64,', 'data:image/png;base64,', 'data:image/png;base64,', 'data:image/png;base64,', 'data:image/png;base64,'];
const ROCKET_SPRITES = ['data:image/png;base64,', 'data:image/png;base64,', 'data:image/png;base64,', 'data:image/png;base64,', 'data:image/png;base64,', 'data:image/png;base64,', 'data:image/png;base64,', 'data:image/png;base64,', 'data:image/png;base64,', 'data:image/png;base64,', 'data:image/png;base64,', 'data:image/png;base64,'];
const monsterImages = MONSTER_SPRITES.map(src => { const im = new Image(); im.src = src; return im; });
const rocketImages = ROCKET_SPRITES.map(src => { const im = new Image(); im.src = src; return im; });

// ── SHOP DATA ──
// Fusées style flat design inspirées de vraies fusées
const SHIPS = {
  ship1: { name: 'Crimson', price: 0, color: '#ffffff', glow: '#55ccff', sprite: 0 },
  ship2: { name: 'Olive', price: 300, color: '#ffffff', glow: '#55ccff', sprite: 1 },
  ship3: { name: 'Azure', price: 600, color: '#ffffff', glow: '#55ccff', sprite: 2 },
  ship4: { name: 'Orange Twin', price: 900, color: '#ffffff', glow: '#55ccff', sprite: 3 },
  ship5: { name: 'Ruby', price: 1200, color: '#ffffff', glow: '#55ccff', sprite: 4 },
  ship6: { name: 'Skyline', price: 1500, color: '#ffffff', glow: '#55ccff', sprite: 5 },
  ship7: { name: 'Amber', price: 1900, color: '#ffffff', glow: '#55ccff', sprite: 6 },
  ship8: { name: 'Scarlet', price: 2300, color: '#ffffff', glow: '#55ccff', sprite: 7 },
  ship9: { name: 'Forest', price: 2800, color: '#ffffff', glow: '#55ccff', sprite: 8 },
  ship10: { name: 'Stealth', price: 3400, color: '#ffffff', glow: '#55ccff', sprite: 9 },
  ship11: { name: 'Solar', price: 4100, color: '#ffffff', glow: '#55ccff', sprite: 10 },
  ship12: { name: 'Blue Titan', price: 5000, color: '#ffffff', glow: '#55ccff', sprite: 11 },
};

// Compatibilité avec les anciennes sauvegardes.
if (!SHIPS[save.equippedShip]) save.equippedShip = 'ship1';
save.ownedShips = (save.ownedShips || []).filter(k => SHIPS[k]);
if (!save.ownedShips.includes('ship1')) save.ownedShips.unshift('ship1');
saveGame(save);

const BACKGROUNDS = {
  deepSpace: { name: 'Deep Space', price: 0,    colors: ['#0a0a1a','#1a0a2e','#0a0a1a'], starColor: '#ffffff' },
  nebula:    { name: 'Nebula',     price: 300,  colors: ['#1a0a2e','#2e0a1a','#1a0a2e'], starColor: '#ffccff' },
  mars:      { name: 'Mars',       price: 600,  colors: ['#1a0505','#2e1505','#1a0505'], starColor: '#ffccaa' },
  cyber:     { name: 'Cyber',      price: 1000, colors: ['#001a0a','#0a1a0a','#001a0a'], starColor: '#00ff88' },
};

// ── GAME STATE ──
let gameRunning = false;
let score = 0;
let wave = 1;
let lives = 3;
let combo = 0;
let comboTimer = 0;

// ── PLAYER ──
const player = {
  x: 400, y: 540, w: 40, h: 50,
  speed: 9,
  shield: false, shieldTimer: 0,
  rapidFire: false, rapidTimer: 0,
  multiShot: false, multiTimer: 0,
  invincible: 0,
  engineParticles: []
};

let bullets = [];
let enemies = [];
let particles = [];
let stars = [];
let powerups = [];
let enemyBullets = [];

// ── INPUT : clavier + souris + doigt ──
const keys = {};
let pointerActive = false;
let pointerX = 400;

function setPointerFromEvent(e) {
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  pointerX = (e.clientX - rect.left) * (canvas.width / rect.width);
  pointerActive = true;
}

document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  keys[e.code] = true;
  if (e.code === 'Space') e.preventDefault();
});
document.addEventListener('keyup', e => keys[e.code] = false);

canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => {
  setPointerFromEvent(e);
  if (canvas.setPointerCapture) canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
  e.preventDefault();
});
canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', e => {
  if (e.pointerType === 'mouse' || pointerActive) setPointerFromEvent(e);
  e.preventDefault();
});
canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', e => {
  pointerActive = false;
  e.preventDefault();
});
canvas.addEventListener('pointercancel', () => { pointerActive = false; });
canvas.addEventListener('pointerleave', e => {
  if (e.pointerType === 'mouse') pointerActive = false;
});

// ── DRAW ROCKET (sprites de la 2e image) ──
function drawRocket(ctx, x, y, shipKey, scale = 1) {
  const ship = SHIPS[shipKey] || SHIPS.ship1;
  const img = rocketImages[ship.sprite ?? 0];
  if (!img || !img.complete || !img.naturalWidth || !img.naturalHeight) {
    // Petit vaisseau de secours si une image n'est pas encore chargée.
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x, y);
    ctx.fillStyle = ship.color || '#ffffff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, -28 * scale);
    ctx.lineTo(18 * scale, 24 * scale);
    ctx.lineTo(0, 16 * scale);
    ctx.lineTo(-18 * scale, 24 * scale);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
    return;
  }
  const maxW = 105, maxH = 95;
  const ratio = Math.min(maxW / img.width, maxH / img.height) * scale;
  const w = img.width * ratio, h = img.height * ratio;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x, y);
  ctx.shadowColor = ship.glow || '#55ccff';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 14;
  ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
  ctx.drawImage(img, -w/2, -h/2, w, h);
  ctx.restore();
}

// ── STARS ──
function initStars() {
  stars = [];
  const bg = BACKGROUNDS[save.equippedBg];
  for (let i = 0; i < 150; i++) {
    stars.push({
      x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
      y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
      size: Math.random() * 2 + 0.5,
      speed: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.3,
      brightness: Math.random(),
      color: bg.starColor
    });
  }
}

// ── SHOOT ──
let lastShot = 0;
function shoot() {
  const now = Date.now();
  const fireRate = player.rapidFire ? 80 : 200;
  if (bullets.length > 80) return;
  if (now - lastShot < fireRate) return;
  lastShot = now;
  playShoot();

  const ship = SHIPS[save.equippedShip];
  if (player.multiShot) {
    bullets.push({ x: player.x, y: player.y - 25, vx: 0, vy: -10, color: ship.color, size: 4 });
    bullets.push({ x: player.x - 15, y: player.y - 20, vx: -2, vy: -9, color: ship.color, size: 3 });
    bullets.push({ x: player.x + 15, y: player.y - 20, vx: 2, vy: -9, color: ship.color, size: 3 });
  } else {
    bullets.push({ x: player.x, y: player.y - 25, vx: 0, vy: -10, color: ship.color, size: 4 });
  }
}

// ── SPAWN ENEMY (monstres de la 1re image) ──
function spawnEnemy() {
  const types = [
    { w: 58, h: 58, hp: 1, speed: 2.0, score: 10, pattern: 'straight', sprite: 0 },
    { w: 64, h: 54, hp: 2, speed: 1.65, score: 20, pattern: 'zigzag', sprite: 1 },
    { w: 52, h: 76, hp: 3, speed: 1.15, score: 30, pattern: 'sine', sprite: 2 },
    { w: 78, h: 55, hp: 2, speed: 2.2, score: 25, pattern: 'fast', sprite: 3 },
    { w: 58, h: 76, hp: 2, speed: 1.9, score: 25, pattern: 'zigzag', sprite: 4 },
    { w: 70, h: 78, hp: 3, speed: 1.35, score: 35, pattern: 'sine', sprite: 5 },
    { w: 62, h: 64, hp: 2, speed: 2.0, score: 30, pattern: 'fast', sprite: 6 },
    { w: 66, h: 66, hp: 4, speed: 1.0, score: 45, pattern: 'sine', sprite: 7 }
  ];
  const available = types.slice(0, Math.min(types.length, 2 + Math.floor(wave / 2)));
  const type = available[Math.floor(Math.random() * available.length)];
  enemies.push({ x: Math.random() * (canvas.width - type.w) + type.w/2, y: -60, ...type,
    maxHp: type.hp, angle: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2, shootTimer: Math.random() * 2000 });
}

// ── PARTICLES ──
function createExplosion(x, y, color, count = 15) {
  // Limite de sécurité pour éviter une surcharge sur téléphone.
  if (particles.length > 500) particles.splice(0, particles.length - 500);
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const angle = (Math.PI * 2 * i) / count + Math.random() * 0.5;
    const speed = Math.random() * 4 + 1;
    particles.push({ x, y, vx: Math.cos(angle)*speed, vy: Math.sin(angle)*speed, life: 1, decay: Math.random()*0.03+0.02, color, size: Math.random()*4+2 });
  }
}
function createEngineParticles() {
  for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
    player.engineParticles.push({
      x: player.x + (Math.random()-0.5)*10, y: player.y+25,
      vx: (Math.random()-0.5)*1, vy: Math.random()*2+2,
      life: 1, decay: 0.05,
      color: `hsl(${20+Math.random()*40},100%,60%)`, size: Math.random()*3+2
    });
  }
}

// ── COLLISION ──
function dist(a, b) { return Math.hypot(a.x-b.x, a.y-b.y); }
function rectCollide(a, b) { return Math.abs(a.x-b.x) < (a.w/2+b.w/2) && Math.abs(a.y-b.y) < (a.h/2+b.h/2); }

// ── UPDATE ──
let enemySpawnTimer = 0;
let enemiesKilledThisWave = 0;
let enemiesNeeded = 10;

function update(dt) {
  const keyLeft = keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['KeyA'];
  const keyRight = keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['KeyD'];

  if (keyLeft || keyRight) {
    if (keyLeft) player.x -= player.speed;
    if (keyRight) player.x += player.speed;
  } else if (pointerActive) {
    const dx = pointerX - player.x;
    player.x += dx * 0.22;
  }
  player.x = Math.max(45, Math.min(canvas.width-45, player.x));

  // Tir automatique.
  shoot();

  if (player.shieldTimer > 0) { player.shieldTimer -= dt; if (player.shieldTimer <= 0) player.shield = false; }
  if (player.rapidTimer > 0) { player.rapidTimer -= dt; if (player.rapidTimer <= 0) player.rapidFire = false; }
  if (player.multiTimer > 0) { player.multiTimer -= dt; if (player.multiTimer <= 0) player.multiShot = false; }
  if (player.invincible > 0) player.invincible -= dt;
  if (comboTimer > 0) { comboTimer -= dt; if (comboTimer <= 0) { combo = 0; comboText.classList.remove('show'); } }

  createEngineParticles();
  for (let i = player.engineParticles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = player.engineParticles[i];
    p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy; p.life -= p.decay;
    if (p.life <= 0) player.engineParticles.splice(i, 1);
  }

  const bg = BACKGROUNDS[save.equippedBg];
  stars.forEach(s => { s.y += s.speed; if (s.y > canvas.height) { s.y = 0; s.x = Math.random()*canvas.width; } s.brightness = 0.5+Math.sin(Date.now()*0.003+s.x)*0.5; });

  for (let i = bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const b = bullets[i];
    b.x += b.vx; b.y += b.vy;
    if (b.y < -10 || b.x < -10 || b.x > canvas.width+10) bullets.splice(i, 1);
  }

  for (let i = enemyBullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const b = enemyBullets[i];
    b.x += b.vx; b.y += b.vy;
    if (b.y > canvas.height+10) {
      enemyBullets.splice(i, 1);
      continue;
    }
    if (dist(b, player) < 22 && player.invincible <= 0) {
      enemyBullets.splice(i, 1);
      hitPlayer();
    }
  }

  enemySpawnTimer += dt;
  const spawnRate = Math.max(400, 1500 - wave*100);
  if (enemySpawnTimer > spawnRate) { enemySpawnTimer = 0; spawnEnemy(); }

  for (let ei = enemies.length - 1; ei >= 0; ei--) {
    const e = enemies[ei];
    e.angle += 0.05;
    if (e.pattern === 'straight') e.y += e.speed;
    else if (e.pattern === 'zigzag') { e.y += e.speed; e.x += Math.sin(e.angle)*2; }
    else if (e.pattern === 'sine') { e.y += e.speed*0.7; e.x += Math.sin(e.angle*2)*3; }
    else if (e.pattern === 'fast') e.y += e.speed;
    e.x = Math.max(e.w/2, Math.min(canvas.width-e.w/2, e.x));

    e.shootTimer += dt;
    if (e.shootTimer > Math.max(700, 3000-wave*200) && e.y > 50 && e.y < 400) {
      e.shootTimer = 0;
      const angle = Math.atan2(player.y-e.y, player.x-e.x);
      enemyBullets.push({ x:e.x, y:e.y+e.h/2, vx:Math.cos(angle)*3, vy:Math.sin(angle)*3, color:'#ff4444', size:5 });
    }

    if (rectCollide(e, player) && player.invincible <= 0) {
      enemies.splice(ei, 1);
      createExplosion(e.x, e.y, e.color, 20);
      hitPlayer();
      continue;
    }
    if (e.y > canvas.height+50) {
      enemies.splice(ei, 1);
      continue;
    }

    let destroyed = false;
    for (let bi = bullets.length - 1; bi >= 0; bi--) {
      const b = bullets[bi];
      if (dist(b, e) < e.w/2+b.size) {
        bullets.splice(bi, 1);
        e.hp--;
        createExplosion(b.x, b.y, '#ffff00', 5);
        if (e.hp <= 0) {
          enemies.splice(ei, 1);
          createExplosion(e.x, e.y, e.color, 25);
          playExplosion();
          combo++;
          comboTimer = 2000;
          const comboMult = Math.min(combo, 5);
          const points = e.score * comboMult;
          score += points;
          enemiesKilledThisWave++;
          if (combo >= 3) {
            comboText.textContent = `COMBO x${comboMult}! +${points}`;
            comboText.classList.add('show');
          }
          spawnPowerup(e.x, e.y);
          destroyed = true;
          break;
        }
      }
    }
    if (destroyed) continue;
  }

  for (let i = powerups.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = powerups[i];
    p.y += p.vy;
    if (p.y > canvas.height+20) {
      powerups.splice(i, 1);
      continue;
    }
    if (dist(p, player) < 30) {
      powerups.splice(i, 1);
      playPowerup(); score += 50; createExplosion(p.x, p.y, p.color, 10);
      if (p.type === 'shield') { player.shield = true; player.shieldTimer = 8000; }
      else if (p.type === 'rapid') { player.rapidFire = true; player.rapidTimer = 6000; }
      else if (p.type === 'multishot') { player.multiShot = true; player.multiTimer = 5000; }
      else if (p.type === 'life') { lives = Math.min(lives+1, 5); }
    }
  }

  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy; p.vx *= 0.98; p.vy *= 0.98; p.life -= p.decay;
    if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
  }

  if (enemiesKilledThisWave >= enemiesNeeded) {
    wave++; enemiesKilledThisWave = 0; enemiesNeeded = 10+wave*3; score += wave*100;
    createExplosion(canvas.width/2, canvas.height/2, '#00ff88', 50);
    comboText.textContent = `WAVE ${wave} !`; comboText.style.color = '#00ff88'; comboText.classList.add('show');
    setTimeout(() => { comboText.classList.remove('show'); comboText.style.color = '#ffaa00'; }, 1500);
  }

  scoreEl.textContent = score; waveEl.textContent = wave; livesEl.textContent = '❤️'.repeat(lives);

  let barHTML = '';
  if (player.shield) barHTML += '<div class="powerup-icon powerup-shield">🛡️</div>';
  if (player.rapidFire) barHTML += '<div class="powerup-icon powerup-rapid">⚡</div>';
  if (player.multiShot) barHTML += '<div class="powerup-icon powerup-multishot">🔥</div>';
  powerupBar.innerHTML = barHTML;
}

function hitPlayer() {
  if (player.shield) { player.shield = false; player.shieldTimer = 0; createExplosion(player.x, player.y, '#00ccff', 20); playHit(); return; }
  lives--; player.invincible = 2000; createExplosion(player.x, player.y, '#ff3366', 30); playHit();
  if (lives <= 0) gameOver();
}

// ── DRAW ──
function draw() {
  const bg = BACKGROUNDS[save.equippedBg];

  // Background gradient
  const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
  grad.addColorStop(0, bg.colors[0]);
  grad.addColorStop(0.5, bg.colors[1]);
  grad.addColorStop(1, bg.colors[2]);
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

  // Stars
  stars.forEach(s => {
    ctx.globalAlpha = s.brightness * 0.8;
    ctx.fillStyle = s.color;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.size, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  });
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // Engine particles
  player.engineParticles.forEach(p => {
    ctx.globalAlpha = p.life;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size*p.life, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  });
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // Player rocket
  ctx.save();
  if (player.shield) {
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(0,204,255,${0.5+Math.sin(Date.now()*0.01)*0.3})`;
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(player.x, player.y, 38, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();
  }
  if (player.invincible > 0 && Math.floor(Date.now()/100)%2 === 0) ctx.globalAlpha = 0.3;
  drawRocket(ctx, player.x, player.y, save.equippedShip);
  ctx.restore();

  // Bullets
  bullets.forEach(b => {
    ctx.shadowColor = b.color; ctx.shadowBlur = 10; ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.size, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.3;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x, b.y+8, b.size*2, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  });

  // Enemy bullets
  enemyBullets.forEach(b => {
    ctx.shadowColor = b.color; ctx.shadowBlur = 8; ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.size, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  });

  // Enemies — sprites de la 1re image
  enemies.forEach(e => {
    ctx.save();
    const img = monsterImages[e.sprite];
    const pulse = 1 + Math.sin(Date.now()*0.006 + e.x)*0.025;
    if (img && img.complete && img.naturalWidth && img.naturalHeight) {
      const maxW = e.w * 1.45, maxH = e.h * 1.45;
      const ratio = Math.min(maxW / img.width, maxH / img.height) * pulse;
      const w = img.width * ratio, h = img.height * ratio;
      ctx.shadowColor = ['#74e33b','#d82cff','#28d8ff','#ff2d78','#39a9ff','#ffd42a','#ff4db8','#70df22'][e.sprite];
      ctx.shadowBlur = 14;
      ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
      ctx.drawImage(img, e.x-w/2, e.y-h/2, w, h);
    }
    if (e.hp < e.maxHp) {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#222'; ctx.fillRect(e.x-20, e.y-e.h/2-10, 40, 5);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4444'; ctx.fillRect(e.x-20, e.y-e.h/2-10, 40*(e.hp/e.maxHp), 5);
    }
    ctx.restore();
  });

  // Powerups
  powerups.forEach(p => {
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(p.x, p.y);
    const pulse = 1+Math.sin(Date.now()*0.008)*0.2;
    ctx.scale(pulse, pulse);
    ctx.shadowColor = p.color; ctx.shadowBlur = 20; ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.3; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, p.size, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.8; ctx.strokeStyle = p.color; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, p.size, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1; ctx.font = '16px Arial'; ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText(p.icon, 0, 1);
    ctx.restore();
  });

  // Particles
  particles.forEach(p => {
    ctx.globalAlpha = p.life; ctx.fillStyle = p.color; ctx.shadowColor = p.color; ctx.shadowBlur = 5;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size*p.life, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  });
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1; ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
}

// ── GAME LOOP ──
let lastTime = 0;
function loop(timestamp) {
  if (!gameRunning) return;
  const dt = Math.min(33, Math.max(0, timestamp - lastTime));
  lastTime = timestamp;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

// ── START / GAME OVER ──
function startGame() {
  initAudio();
  stopMenuLoop();
  gameRunning = true;
  score = 0; wave = 1; lives = 3; combo = 0; comboTimer = 0;
  bullets = []; enemies = []; particles = []; powerups = []; enemyBullets = [];
  player.x = 400; player.y = 540;
  pointerActive = false;
  pointerX = player.x;
  player.shield = false; player.rapidFire = false; player.multiShot = false;
  player.invincible = 0;
  enemySpawnTimer = 0; enemiesKilledThisWave = 0; enemiesNeeded = 10;

  initStars();
  menuOverlay.classList.add('hidden');
  shopOverlay.classList.add('hidden');
  instrOverlay.classList.add('hidden');
  gameOverOverlay.classList.add('hidden');
  document.getElementById('gameOverText').textContent = '💀 GAME OVER';
  ui.style.display = 'flex';
  helpBtn.style.display = 'flex';
  lastTime = performance.now();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

function gameOver() {
  gameRunning = false;
  playGameOver();

  const earned = Math.floor(score / 10);
  save.coins += earned;
  if (score > save.highScore) save.highScore = score;
  saveGame(save);

  document.getElementById('finalScore').textContent = `Score: ${score}`;
  document.getElementById('coinsEarned').textContent = `+${earned} crédits`;
  document.getElementById('highScoreDisplay').textContent = `🏆 Record: ${save.highScore}`;

  ui.style.display = 'none';
  helpBtn.style.display = 'none';
  gameOverOverlay.classList.remove('hidden');
}

// ── SHOP SYSTEM ──
function renderShop() {
  shopCoinsEl.textContent = save.coins;

  // Ships
  const shipsSection = document.getElementById('shipsSection');
  shipsSection.innerHTML = '';
  Object.entries(SHIPS).forEach(([key, ship]) => {
    const owned = save.ownedShips.includes(key);
    const equipped = save.equippedShip === key;
    const div = document.createElement('div');
    div.className = 'shop-item' + (owned ? ' owned' : '') + (equipped ? ' equipped' : '') + (!owned && save.coins < ship.price ? ' locked' : '');

    // Aperçu avec le sprite de la 2e image
    const preview = document.createElement('img');
    preview.src = ROCKET_SPRITES[ship.sprite ?? 0];
    preview.className = 'item-preview';
    preview.style.objectFit = 'contain';
    preview.style.imageRendering = 'pixelated';

    div.innerHTML = `
      <div class="item-equipped">${equipped ? '✓' : ''}</div>
      <div class="item-name">${ship.name}</div>
      <div class="item-price">${owned ? '<span class="item-owned">Possédé</span>' : `💰 ${ship.price}`}</div>
    `;
    div.insertBefore(preview, div.firstChild);

    div.onclick = () => {
      if (equipped) return;
      if (owned) {
        save.equippedShip = key; saveGame(save); playEquip(); renderShop();
      } else if (save.coins >= ship.price) {
        save.coins -= ship.price;
        save.ownedShips.push(key);
        save.equippedShip = key;
        saveGame(save); playBuy(); renderShop();
      }
    };
    shipsSection.appendChild(div);
  });

  // Backgrounds
  const bgSection = document.getElementById('bgSection');
  bgSection.innerHTML = '';
  Object.entries(BACKGROUNDS).forEach(([key, bg]) => {
    const owned = save.ownedBgs.includes(key);
    const equipped = save.equippedBg === key;
    const div = document.createElement('div');
    div.className = 'shop-item' + (owned ? ' owned' : '') + (equipped ? ' equipped' : '') + (!owned && save.coins < bg.price ? ' locked' : '');

    // Mini gradient preview
    const preview = document.createElement('div');
    preview.className = 'item-preview';
    preview.style.background = `linear-gradient(180deg, ${bg.colors[0]}, ${bg.colors[1]})`;
    preview.style.borderRadius = '4px';

    div.innerHTML = `
      <div class="item-equipped">${equipped ? '✓' : ''}</div>
      <div class="item-name">${bg.name}</div>
      <div class="item-price">${owned ? '<span class="item-owned">Possédé</span>' : `💰 ${bg.price}`}</div>
    `;
    div.insertBefore(preview, div.firstChild);

    div.onclick = () => {
      if (equipped) return;
      if (owned) {
        save.equippedBg = key; saveGame(save); playEquip(); renderShop();
      } else if (save.coins >= bg.price) {
        save.coins -= bg.price;
        save.ownedBgs.push(key);
        save.equippedBg = key;
        saveGame(save); playBuy(); renderShop();
      }
    };
    bgSection.appendChild(div);
  });
}

// ── MENU ANIMATION ──
// Un seul menuLoop à la fois : cela évite que les animations
// s'empilent après plusieurs parties et finissent par ralentir le jeu.
let menuAnimId = null;
let menuLoopRunning = false;
let menuShipX = 400;
let menuShipDir = 1;

function menuLoop() {
  if (menuLoopRunning || gameRunning) return;
  menuLoopRunning = true;

  const frame = () => {
    if (!menuLoopRunning || gameRunning) {
      menuLoopRunning = false;
      menuAnimId = null;
      return;
    }

    const bg = BACKGROUNDS[save.equippedBg];
    const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
    grad.addColorStop(0, bg.colors[0]);
    grad.addColorStop(0.5, bg.colors[1]);
    grad.addColorStop(1, bg.colors[2]);
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    if (stars.length === 0) initStars();
    stars.forEach(s => {
      s.y += s.speed * 0.3;
      if (s.y > canvas.height) { s.y = 0; s.x = Math.random()*canvas.width; }
      ctx.globalAlpha = (0.5+Math.sin(Date.now()*0.003+s.x)*0.5) * 0.6;
      ctx.fillStyle = s.color;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.size, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    });
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    menuShipX += menuShipDir * 0.5;
    if (menuShipX > 450 || menuShipX < 350) menuShipDir *= -1;
    drawRocket(ctx, menuShipX, 300, save.equippedShip, 1.3);

    menuAnimId = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  };

  menuAnimId = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}

function stopMenuLoop() {
  menuLoopRunning = false;
  if (menuAnimId !== null) {
    cancelAnimationFrame(menuAnimId);
    menuAnimId = null;
  }
}

// ── SÉCURITÉ ──
// Une erreur technique ne doit JAMAIS afficher "GAME OVER".
// La partie se termine uniquement quand les vies arrivent à 0.
window.addEventListener('error', (event) => {
  console.error('Erreur technique détectée :', event.error || event.message);
});

// ── EVENT LISTENERS ──
document.getElementById('startBtn').addEventListener('click', startGame);

document.getElementById('shopBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
  initAudio();
  menuOverlay.classList.add('hidden');
  shopOverlay.classList.remove('hidden');
  renderShop();
  shopScrollBox.scrollTop = 0;
});

document.getElementById('shopBackBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
  shopOverlay.classList.add('hidden');
  menuOverlay.classList.remove('hidden');
  menuCoinsEl.textContent = save.coins;
});

// Flèches de défilement boutique
document.getElementById('shopScrollUp').addEventListener('click', () => {
  shopScrollBox.scrollBy({ top: -120, behavior: 'smooth' });
});
document.getElementById('shopScrollDown').addEventListener('click', () => {
  shopScrollBox.scrollBy({ top: 120, behavior: 'smooth' });
});

document.getElementById('helpBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
  if (!gameRunning) return;
  gameRunning = false;
  instrOverlay.classList.remove('hidden');
});

document.getElementById('instrBackBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
  instrOverlay.classList.add('hidden');
  if (ui.style.display !== 'none') {
    gameRunning = true;
    lastTime = performance.now();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
});

document.getElementById('restartBtn').addEventListener('click', startGame);

document.getElementById('goMenuBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
  gameOverOverlay.classList.add('hidden');
  menuOverlay.classList.remove('hidden');
  menuCoinsEl.textContent = save.coins;
  menuLoop();
});

// ── INIT ──
menuCoinsEl.textContent = save.coins;
menuLoop();
</script>
</body>
</html>
